title: Gotrade Daily: AI Chip Rally Reignites Tonight
summary: AI chip stocks reignite on Meta's Muse agent, dividend hikes roll in, and oil slips below US$100. Here's your US watchlist for tonight.
body_markdown:
### Paramount-Warner Bros. Discovery merger cleared


Paramount won its takeover of Warner Bros. after settling lawsuits from several states and unions. The deal reframes the read for **Netflix ([NFLX](https://www.heygotrade.com/en/us-stock/nflx/) )** and the wider streaming landscape.


## Pre-Market Pulse 📊


US futures are firmer this morning on the AI rally and softer oil. Beyond the chip names, attention sits on dividend stories like JPMorgan and McDonald's. Per-stock pre-market moves will be updated closer to the US open.


## Macro Note 📝


Oil slipped back below US$100 after Trump opened diplomacy with Iran, adding a risk-on tailwind. Gold eased as investors trimmed safe-haven exposure. On the other side, signals from a Fed official about a possible further rate hike and this week's US macro data still warrant attention.


## Conclusion


Tonight's big theme is risk appetite returning: the AI chip rally, dividend hikes, and easing oil all point the same way. The combination can sustain momentum, though rate-hike signals and Texas's data-center permit audit are reminders that the AI story carries risk.


For those watching US stocks, the focus is whether chip leadership holds into the open and how the dividend names absorb any rotation. Track the watchlist above and plan ahead before the session starts.
